subject: Private cluster patching — decision rules, maintenance window asks, and fallback plan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private cluster patching — decision rules and ask for the Serene window

Team —

We have Serene Health's maintenance window negotiation coming up. They responded to our initial maintenance proposal and want a clearer acceptance rubric and explicit rollback SLAs before they sign the change request. I want to lock in our internal decision rules and the minimum telemetry/acceptance tests we need to run during the window.

Ask: please review the attached patch catalog and the proposed rollback checklist, then reply with the following by EOD today:
- Which builds in the catalog must be pinned for the 2-week staging window? (explicit build hashes)
- What are go/no-go criteria (metrics & traffic thresholds) for each stage?
- Minimum personnel coverage during the window (engineer + SRE + CS POC)

I've attached the patch-catalog-2026Q2.csv and rollback-checklist.md for context. I started a short doc for decisions here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cPatchDecisionLog (please add comments instead of editing raw text).

Background: Serene wants two 2-hour windows next week (weekday evening or weekend morning) and an explicit failure-abort SLA: if P50 latency increases >2x for 10m or error rate >1.5% for 5m we must abort and rollback. They asked for an explicit runbook and an estimate of customer-visible downtime if rollback triggers.

Thanks — I want to get alignment before I propose final times.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Lead, Private Deployments 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: patch-catalog-2026Q2.csv (CSV, 48KB)]
[Attachment: rollback-checklist.md (Markdown, 12KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster patching — decision rules and ask for the Serene window

Olga — thanks for initiating. Quick notes after skimming the catalog and checklist:

> Which builds must be pinned for the 2-week staging window?
- Pin all control-plane components to the last-green build: cp-2026.03.18-hashB7 (this is the only build we've validated with the newer network driver).
- Worker runtime: keep at worker-2026.02.09-hashD2 for staging; only advance worker runtime in canaries with KV-cache warmup.

> Go/no-go criteria (metrics & traffic thresholds)
- Preflight (0–30m after canary start): no more than 0.5% 5xxs and CPU usage <75% per GPU node.
- Progressive rollout (30m–2h): P95 latency delta <= +40ms vs baseline, error rate <= 1.0%. If either fails for 3 continuous 1-minute samples, pause and rollback the canary.
- Full window: P50 <= baseline*1.5; P99 not regressing by >200ms sustained for 10m.

> Minimum coverage
- Production lead (Monica) — on-call during window
- SRE (Neha) — network & infra rollback auth 
- Support lead (assigned) — customer comms

Also: add the KV-cache health check (cache hit ratio > 70%) as an acceptance test for the worker runtime advance — we've seen regressions there in prior upgrades.

I've updated the rollback-checklist.md with an initial list of node-eviction and image-swap steps. See attached.

-Markus
[Quoted text from Olga Petrov: ...]
[Attachment: rollback-checklist.md (updated, Markdown, 14KB)]

From: Jason Li <jason.li@serenehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@serenehealth.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster patching — decision rules and ask for the Serene window

Thanks, Olga/Monica — this is helpful. A couple items from the Serene ops team: 

- Preferred windows: Thu 2026-04-09 18:00–20:00 PT (preferred) or Sat 2026-04-11 06:00–08:00 PT (backup).
- Regarding rollback impact: our primary concern is customer-visible session loss for API clients. Can you confirm expected maximum session gap during an image-swap rollback for our current traffic profile?
- Compliance asks: we need a signed copy of your rollback checklist and an audit trail showing who executed the rollback steps. Can you include an audit hook (simple webhook/call into our audit collector) in the runbook?

We'll be able to accept the change if you can: 1) confirm the window and 2) provide the signed checklist and the audit hook detail.

Thanks —
Jason Li
Director of Platform Ops, Serene Health
[Attachment: Serene-maint-window-request-form.pdf (PDF, 56KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jason Li <jason.li@serenehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster patching — decision rules and ask for the Serene window

Jason — thanks for the clarity and for the form. Confirmed items and next steps below: 

1) Window: we will propose Thu 2026-04-09 18:00–20:00 PT as primary and keep Sat 2026-04-11 06:00–08:00 PT as the fallback. I'll send the formal change request once Serene confirms the primary.

2) Rollback impact estimate: for your current traffic profile a full image-swap rollback with pre-warmed control-plane peers should produce at most a 45–90s visible session gap for long-lived connections (we will attempt in-place container swap first which keeps most short-lived RPCs unaffected). We will document this in the signed checklist.

3) Audit hook: Monica, can you add the webhook snippet to the runbook and include the expected webhook payload schema (customer wants user, step, timestamp, result)? Markus, please add the explicit KV-cache health check to the acceptance tests (see your earlier note). Neha, please confirm you can act as rollback authorizer and that SRE retains emergency SSH access during the window.

Deliverables before we send CR to Serene:
- Signed rollback-checklist.md (we will collect a digital sign-off from Monica + Neha)
- Short runbook with the audit webhook example (Monica) 
- Updated decision doc with the pinned build hashes and the canary plan (Markus)

Target: deliver all artifacts by Tue EOD (2026-04-06) so we have a day to get legal to attach the signed checklist to the CR.

Olga
Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: maintenance-window-request-form.pdf (forwarded from Serene, PDF, 56KB)]
